entries.en: Choose a field declared in data.fields; do not invent data.
entries.zh-CN: 使用 data.fields 已声明字段，不编造数据。

entries.en: Use ordinal x for bar/line/pie and quantitative x for scatter; y is quantitative.
entries.zh-CN: 柱状/折线/饼图 x 为 ordinal，散点 x 为 quantitative，y 为 quantitative。

entries.en: Aggregate explicitly upstream or split series; duplicate categories are not auto-summed.
entries.zh-CN: 在上游显式聚合或拆分系列，重复分类不会自动求和。

entries.en: Refresh host data metadata or capture the current chart revision before starting an update.
entries.zh-CN: 刷新宿主数据元信息，或在开始更新前获取当前图表版本。

entries.en: Use inline data or ask the host to register the data reference.
entries.zh-CN: 使用内联数据或由宿主注册引用。

entries.en: Read capabilities and use a supported declarative feature.
entries.zh-CN: 读取能力清单，使用受支持声明式能力。

entries.en: Reduce chart complexity before retrying.
entries.zh-CN: 降低图表复杂度后重试。

entries.en: Wait for an active render to finish before retrying.
entries.zh-CN: 等待当前渲染结束后重试。

entries.en: Use a new operation ID for a different payload.
entries.zh-CN: 不同内容请使用新的操作 ID。

entries.en: Provide a valid operation ID, base revision and completion state.
entries.zh-CN: 提供有效的操作 ID、基础版本和完成状态。

entries.en: The update was cancelled before commit; retry if needed.
entries.zh-CN: 更新在提交前已取消，可按需重试。

entries.en: Start a new stream buffer after completion, cancellation or failure.
entries.zh-CN: 流完成、取消或失败后，请创建新的缓冲器。

entries.en: Use the native-strict-basic-0.1 schema and repair the indicated field; strict validation covers a small subset only.
entries.zh-CN: 参照 native-strict-basic-0.1 Schema 修复所示字段；严格校验只覆盖有限子集。

entries.en: All pie values are zero, so shares cannot be computed. Preserve data; do not invent nonzero values.
entries.zh-CN: 饼图数值全为零，无法计算占比。保留数据，不编造非零值。

entries.en: Use unique nonempty string values in the declared keyField.
entries.zh-CN: 声明 keyField 的值必须是唯一非空字符串。

entries.en: Increase export dimensions; do not remove data to make the export fit.
entries.zh-CN: 增大导出尺寸，不得通过删除数据来适配。

entries.en: Use the full source and rendered-value views when the chart does not fit.
entries.zh-CN: 图表空间不足时，通过完整源数据和渲染值入口查看。

entries.en: Chart semantics changed; legend selections were reset.
entries.zh-CN: 图表语义改变，已重置图例选择。

entries.en: Dense labels are available through full data access.
entries.zh-CN: 标签过密，完整内容可从数据入口访问。

entries.en: Wait for a successful terminal frame; do not commit parseable partial output.
entries.zh-CN: 必须等待成功终止帧，不提交仅能解析的部分输出。

entries.en: Generation was truncated; request a new complete result.
entries.zh-CN: 生成被截断，请重新请求完整结果。

entries.en: Transport framing or UTF-8 was invalid; preserve the previous chart.
entries.zh-CN: 传输帧或 UTF-8 无效，保留上次图表。

entries.en: Fix the host callback; committed chart data remains separate.
entries.zh-CN: 修复宿主回调，已提交图表数据不受回调错误影响。

entries.en: Use 1–6 uniquely named items, 3–8 distinct indicators and explicit ranges; never impute missing values.
entries.zh-CN: 使用1–6个唯一名称对象、3–8个不同指标与明确范围，不填补缺失值。

entries.en: Check unique node IDs, one root, parent references, cycles and depth <=16. Do not remove source nodes silently.
entries.zh-CN: 检查唯一节点ID、唯一根、父引用、环和深度≤16，不静默删除源节点。

entries.en: Check node/edge limits, endpoints, duplicate pairs, cycles and nonnegative flow. Never fabricate conservation.
entries.zh-CN: 检查节点/边上限、端点、重复边、环和非负流量，不伪造守恒。

entries.en: Match registered region keys exactly and preserve null; check explicit color domain and duplicate rows.
entries.zh-CN: 精确匹配注册区域键，保留null，检查显式色域与重复行。

entries.en: Ask the host to register an authorized map; list_capabilities exposes available metadata, not geometry.
entries.zh-CN: 由宿主注册已授权地图；list_capabilities提供可用元信息而非几何。

entries.en: Use the exact host asset revision; do not overwrite a registered map revision.
entries.zh-CN: 使用准确宿主版本，不覆盖已注册地图版本。

entries.en: Host must rebuild a validated asset snapshot; never disable integrity checks.
entries.zh-CN: 由宿主重建有效资产快照，不关闭完整性检查。

entries.en: Host must validate supported WGS84 polygons, keys, metadata and limits. Geometry is not a model argument.
entries.zh-CN: 宿主校验受支持WGS84多边形、区域键、元信息和限制；几何不是模型参数。

entries.en: Use a smaller authorized asset or a fresh renderer when registration capacity is exhausted.
entries.zh-CN: 使用更小的已授权资产；注册容量耗尽时使用新渲染进程。

entries.en: This view is a collapsed overview; full source hierarchy remains in the data table and SVG metadata.
entries.zh-CN: 当前为折叠概览，完整源层级保留在数据表和SVG元信息中。
